figures.finding: Majority comes at eighteen under canon law, the State's first source of law; a minor exercises his rights subject to his parents' or guardians' authority. No rule on a minor's performing contract or earnings was found.
figures.applies: Vatican City State; canon law as first source (Law LXXI of 2008, art. 1, as layer 3 holds).

sources.said: A person who has completed the eighteenth year of age has reached majority; below this age, a person is a minor.
A minor, in the exercise of his or her rights, remains subject to the authority of parents or guardians

sources.title: Code of Canon Law, cann. 96-123 (vatican.va), the first source of Vatican City law
